facts.business: ASK Automotive is among India's leading manufacturers of automotive components, delivering high-performance and safety-critical solutions to the mobility sector, with a focus on braking systems, aluminium precision solutions, and safety control cables for both conventional and electric vehicles.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Increase the inclusion of women in the workers' category

Continue tracking training imparted to other-than-permanent (contract) workers and progressively increase coverage
Strengthen ESG assessment coverage across value chain partners

guidance_or_targets.statement: Increase the share of renewable energy in total energy consumption

auditor.name: M/s Mehta & Mehta, Company Secretaries
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company has not submitted the prior intimation in PDF format to the Stock Exchange(s) under Regulation 29(1)(e) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, in respect of the Board Meeting convened to consider and recommend the final dividend. However, intimation in XBRL mode was done by the company as required.

Resignation of Independent Director Mr. Arun Duggal due to personal reasons
